BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.WISH.title: Unattended Store
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.WISH.intro: Nobody stands behind the counter. A note at the foot of a suit of armor asks you to bring in some barrels in exchange for a collectible.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.WISH.refreshed: Thick black fluid seeps from the opened barrel. The rewards by the armor have changed. Carry in the barrels to take one.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.WISH.result: You set the barrels by the counter. The gauntlet opens and hands you {item}.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.WISH.empty: The barrels are still here, but there are no collectibles left to claim.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.WISH.barrel.2: Push the huge barrel on wheels
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.WISH.refresh.descrip: Spend 4 Originium Ingots to see a selection of rarer collectibles.
